name: ForB
source:
Boy plays during summer vacation to create memories. But holidays are over. New life and new encounters await him. And he meets that girl again. And they share memories. Under the same sky time flow stops and it's unclear anymore what is past and what is future.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
少年在暑假里尽情玩耍，留下了许多回忆。然而，假期结束了，新的生活与邂逅正等待着他。他再次遇见那位少女，两人分享着彼此的回忆。同一片天空下，时间的流动仿佛停滞，过去与未来也变得难以分辨。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
